headline: Exosens Shares Jump 6% on German Army Night Vision Order
summary: Exosens shares climbed 6% following an order from the German army for night vision equipment.
why: Exosens supplies electro-optical components for defense applications; government defense contracts provide reliable, long-term revenue streams.

impacts.name: Exosens
impacts.why: A direct procurement order from the German military boosts corporate revenue expectations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The new defense procurement order validated market demand for the company's specialized imaging and night vision technology.
